Hi Sandra,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To keep momentum on schedule for your May 6 production cutover, we need to align on access controls and a few artifacts from Globex before we start the private deployment runbook. Below is a concise list of what we need and a proposed owner for each item — if anything should be routed to a different person on your side, let me know and I will update the plan.

Required items (please share via secure upload or email):
- SAML IdP metadata (entityID, certificate, ACS URLs) — owner: IT Ops
- SCIM provisioning mapping (CSV) and preferred service account model (bearer token or SCIM API key) — owner: IT Ops
- Static egress IP ranges for allowlist (CIDR blocks) and planned regional endpoints — owner: NetOps
- List of internal roles that map to SSO groups (minimum: admin, ops, read-only) — owner: Security

Can you share the SAML metadata and the SCIM CSV this week? Karthik (access engineering) and Neha (onboarding) will be our primary implementers; Laura (solutions) will coordinate any contract/SLA questions.

Next steps:
1) You send metadata + mapping by 2028-04-14.
2) We schedule a 45-minute technical run-through the week of 2028-04-17.
3) Implementation/validation on staging by 2028-04-24.

Attachments: none on my side yet — I will follow up with our onboarding checklist and the recommended SAML attribute mapping template.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Globex — SAML/SCIM validation checklist and IP allowlist

Thanks Marissa — I validated the attached SAML metadata and have a short implementation checklist below. Sandra, I tried to keep this high signal so your NetOps and IdP folks can act quickly.

SAML validation checklist (action items):
- Verify EntityID matches our SP entry: urn:redwood:globex:sp
- ACS URLs: add staging and prod endpoints (staging: https://staging.globex.com/saml/acs, prod: https://app.globex.com/saml/acs)
- Certificate: confirm fingerprint (SHA256) and send over the cert expiration date
- NameID format: use transient for service accounts; email for user login flows
- Attribute mapping (recommended):
  - eduPersonPrincipalName -> user.principal_name
  - mail -> user.email
  - groups -> user.groups (SCIM group sync will be used for RBAC)
- Session & assertion settings: set assertion lifetime to <= 5 minutes and sessionNotOnOrAfter to 8 hours (we recommend max 8h for prod, 24h only with justification)

SCIM / service account guidance (Neha and ops):
- Use a long-lived service account token with periodic rotation; Redwood supports token rotation hooks — we recommend a 90-day rotation cadence and an emergency revocation endpoint.
- SCIM mapping: ensure group -> role mapping is included in scim-mapping.csv and include group IDs that match your IdP.
- Bulk provisioning: test incremental sync on staging first (we will seed 100 users).

IP allowlist (for private endpoints):
- Please confirm outbound ranges you already provided. We will also give you the IPs for the private ingress endpoints once we finalize the deployment region.

Security & org policies (notes for Security team):
- Enforce SSO-only for admin roles; deny local passwords for accounts in admin group.
- Audit logs: enable verbose audit retention for 90 days for the first 30 days after cutover.

Deliverables from Redwood by 2028-04-17:
- onboarding checklist PDF (redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf)
- exact IPs to whitelist for staging and prod
- sample SAML attribute mapping (inline and Drive link)

If that looks right I will paste these items into a confluence-style checklist and we can walk through on 4/18.

-Karthik
Lead, Access Engineering
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
